recommendations.finding: Refine is unconditional for every model-translated segment.
recommendations.evidence: Offline scenarios produced 5 refine calls and 5 draft calls; refine prompts include the entire draft prompt again.
recommendations.optimization: A/B single-pass bulk translation; retain refine only for frontier/risk/QA failures.
recommendations.estimated_effect: Removes about 4187 estimated prompt tokens and 5 calls in this fixture suite.
recommendations.quality_gate: Paid blinded comparison on representative pages is required before changing behavior.

recommendations.finding: All glossary terms are injected into every segment and duplicated in refine.
recommendations.evidence: The representative prompt includes 12 terms although only 1 appears in the short source.
recommendations.optimization: Filter glossary to source-matching terms plus a very small global must-include set.
recommendations.estimated_effect: Savings grow linearly with termbase size and are doubled by current refinement.
recommendations.quality_gate: Unit-test Arabic normalization and multi-word matching; no paid call needed.

recommendations.finding: OCR confidence now reaches routing, but translation confidence is still hard-coded.
recommendations.evidence: Low-confidence OCR is routed directly to frontier; OpenRouter translation adapters still return fixed 0.86/0.89 values.
recommendations.optimization: Keep the OCR safeguard and later replace adapter constants with calibrated QA signals.
recommendations.estimated_effect: Targets frontier spend at visibly uncertain source text without reducing translation quality.
recommendations.quality_gate: Build a labeled OCR/translation error set and calibrate thresholds.

recommendations.finding: Frontier Gemini Pro costs roughly 4x Flash at current list rates.
recommendations.optimization: Keep Pro only where a blinded Arabic quality test proves material improvement; test Flash on long segments and Pro only on doctrinal/canonical misses.
recommendations.estimated_effect: Each moved frontier token costs about one quarter as much on Flash at list price.
recommendations.quality_gate: Human review by an Arabic/Islamic-text expert is mandatory.

recommendations.finding: Chat resends a large static knowledge block and all tool schemas on every tool round.
recommendations.evidence: The chat loop allows five calls and accumulates the conversation while repeating the same system/tools prefix.
recommendations.optimization: Test Flash-Lite for chat and cap/compact history; preserve Flash fallback for tool failures.
recommendations.estimated_effect: Flash-Lite list rates are 67% lower for input and 84% lower for output than Flash, before quality/tool-reliability effects.
recommendations.quality_gate: Replay tool-choice and authorization test cases before switching.

recommendations.finding: The production database cannot answer which model/pass/reason spent each token.
recommendations.evidence: usage_ledger persists only stage=ingest/chat totals; segment.engine is the shared label openrouter-cloud.
recommendations.optimization: Add a per-call audit table/JSON event with model, operation, route reason, page/segment, provider tokens, cost, latency, and retry count.
recommendations.estimated_effect: Observability improvement; no direct token saving, but enables evidence-based routing.
recommendations.quality_gate: Schema migration and privacy review before any production deployment.
